metadata.Short Title: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
metadata.Long Title: An Act to provide for more effective protection of the rights of women guaranteed under the Constitution who are victims of violence of any kind occurring within the family and formatters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
metadata.Department: Department of WOMAN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT
metadata.Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Women and Child Development, )
metadata.Notification: 26th October, 2006, vide notification No. S.O. 1776(E), dated by 17th October, 2006, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
